name: Vindictive Display
body:
You strike fear into the hearts of onlookers when you destroy the living with corrupting power.

Prerequisite(s): Touch of corruption class feature

Benefit(s): When you reduce a creature to below 0 hp with a touch of corruption, or when a creature fails its saving throw to resist your cruelty, you can make an Intimidate check to demoralize all foes within 30 feet who can see the result.

Special: This feat counts as Dazzling Display for the purpose of prerequisites.
